invariants.one_lifecycle_engine: LifecycleEngine in lifecycle/engine.ts is the single production lifecycle engine
invariants.one_terminal_predicate: Oracle v2 (evaluateAttemptOracle) via CompletionService is the single production completion predicate
invariants.one_terminalization_service: CompletionService in lifecycle/completion-service.ts is the sole lifecycle-layer route to Oracle v2
invariants.one_transactional_state_authority: StateStore in state/store.ts is the single transactional state authority
invariants.one_process_supervisor: ProcessSupervisor in process/supervisor.ts is the single process supervisor
invariants.no_nullable_completion_shortcut: No production code passes gateGreen: null as a completion input
invariants.no_direct_done_writer: No production code sets ticket status to Done outside the LifecycleEngine
invariants.no_terminal_writer_shortcut: Registry.updateTicketState terminal writer is removed from production code
invariants.no_dispatch_completion_caller: The dispatch.completion caller is not in the evaluateCompletion allowlist
invariants.no_gather_completion_evidence: gatherCompletionEvidence is not exported from dispatch/evidence.ts
invariants.no_template_literal_completion_shortcut: No template-literal interpolation in production source contains forbidden completion shortcuts

production_wiring.t27_review: performReview in lifecycle/review.ts is the production review authority; rejection routed through runBoundedRemediationLoop in lifecycle/remediation.ts
production_wiring.t27_remediation: runBoundedRemediationLoop in lifecycle/remediation.ts is the production bounded remediation authority
production_wiring.t28_oracle: CompletionService.evaluateAttemptCompletion is the sole lifecycle-layer route to Oracle v2; AttemptRunner oracle provider routes through CompletionService
production_wiring.t29_resume: resumeRun in lifecycle/recovery.ts is the production resume entrypoint; build --resume calls resumeRun
production_wiring.t30_audit: terminal-writer-audit.test.ts detects template-literal interpolations in executable strings
